name: DCX Points-to-Voxels
aliases: Point Cloud Voxelization via Space Index Array
definition: Converts a set of 3D points into a sparse voxel representation by averaging point positions within grid cells defined by a bounding box and resolution.
summary: DCX Points-to-Voxels converts 3D points into a sparse voxel grid by averaging geometric and color data per cell, differing from simple occupancy methods by storing averaged values and from dense voxelization by using hash maps.
